<style>
#proc-root{
  min-height:420px
}
.proc-toolbar{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin:0 0 10px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.96);
  box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(17,49,60,.04)
}
.proc-toolbar input{
  width:min(620px,100%);
  min-height:38px!important
}
.proc-count{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  color:#60726f;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:750
}
.proc-layout{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,.75fr) minmax(0,1.25fr);
  gap:12px
}
.proc-list,
.proc-detail{
  min-width:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.97);
  box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(17,49,60,.05)
}
.proc-list{
  display:grid;
  align-content:start
}
.proc-case-item{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:38px minmax(0,1fr) auto!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  gap:10px!important;
  width:100%!important;
  min-height:76px!important;
  padding:11px 13px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e9e4db!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  color:#27444f!important;
  text-align:left!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
.proc-case-item:last-child{border-bottom:0!important}
.proc-case-item:hover,
.proc-case-item.active{
  transform:none!important;
  background:#edf5f3!important
}
.proc-case-item.active{
  box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--pda-sea)!important
}
.proc-case-icon{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:36px;
  height:36px;
  border-radius:10px;
  color:var(--pda-sea);
  background:#e5f0ee
}
.proc-case-icon svg{
  width:19px;
  height:19px;
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.8;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round
}
.proc-case-copy{
  display:grid;
  min-width:0;
  gap:2px
}
.proc-case-copy strong{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#173f51;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.proc-case-copy span{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#3f5c66;
  font-size:9px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.proc-case-copy small{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#7b8883;
  font-size:8px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.proc-case-meta{
  display:grid;
  justify-items:end;
  gap:3px;
  color:#7a8883;
  font-size:7.6px
}
.proc-case-arrow{
  color:var(--pda-sea);
  font-size:18px
}
.proc-detail{
  padding:18px
}
.proc-detail-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px;
  padding-bottom:14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e4dfd6
}
.proc-detail-kicker{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:3px;
  color:var(--pda-sea);
  font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:850;
  letter-spacing:.14em
}
.proc-detail h3{
  margin:0!important;
  color:var(--pda-ink)!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-display)!important;
  font-size:24px!important;
  font-weight:650!important;
  letter-spacing:-.02em
}
.proc-detail-head p{
  margin:4px 0 0!important
}
.proc-facts{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:0;
  margin:14px 0 0;
  border-top:1px solid #e4dfd6;
  border-left:1px solid #e4dfd6
}
.proc-fact{
  min-width:0;
  padding:11px 12px;
  border-right:1px solid #e4dfd6;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e4dfd6
}
.proc-fact span{
  display:block;
  color:#7a8883;
  font-size:8px
}
.proc-fact strong{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  color:#314f5a;
  font-size:10px
}
.proc-detail-note{
  margin-top:15px;
  padding:15px;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(232,242,239,.92),rgba(248,246,240,.92));
  border:1px solid #d9e3df
}
.proc-detail-note h4{
  margin:0 0 4px;
  color:#274650;
  font-family:var(--pda-display);
  font-size:15px
}
.proc-detail-note p{
  margin:0!important
}
.proc-empty{
  margin:0;
  padding:24px;
  color:#778580;
  font-size:9px;
  text-align:center
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .proc-layout{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .proc-list{
    max-height:340px;
    overflow:auto
  }
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .proc-toolbar,
  .proc-detail-head{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .proc-facts{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}

.proc-detail-actions{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:6px
}
.proc-detail-actions button{
  min-height:32px!important;
  padding:6px 9px!important;
  font-size:7.8px!important
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .proc-detail-actions{
    justify-content:flex-start
  }
}


.proc-datajud-mini{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:17px;
  padding:2px 6px;
  border-radius:999px;
  font-size:6.8px;
  font-weight:850;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
  color:#52645f;
  background:#eef0ec
}
.proc-datajud-mini.status-atualizado{
  color:#17684f;
  background:#e4f3ec
}
.proc-datajud-mini.status-falha,
.proc-datajud-mini.status-nao_localizado{
  color:#8a4938;
  background:#f9e9e2
}
.proc-datajud-sync{
  color:#fff!important;
  background:#0d7885!important;
  border-color:#0d7885!important
}
.proc-datajud-sync:hover{
  background:#086773!important
}
.proc-datajud-status{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-top:14px;
  padding:13px 14px;
  border:1px solid #d8e3df;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#f2f7f5
}
.proc-datajud-status h4,
.proc-datajud-section h4{
  margin:1px 0 3px!important;
  color:#244a55!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-display)!important;
  font-size:16px!important
}
.proc-datajud-status.status-atualizado{
  border-color:#bfddd1;
  background:#edf7f2
}
.proc-datajud-status.status-falha,
.proc-datajud-status.status-nao_localizado{
  border-color:#ebcabc;
  background:#fff3ee
}
.proc-datajud-error{
  margin:6px 0 0!important;
  color:#914b38;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:700
}
.proc-datajud-facts{
  margin-top:10px
}
.proc-datajud-section{
  margin-top:16px;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fffdf9
}
.proc-section-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e7e2d9;
  background:#f8f6f1
}
.proc-section-title{
  min-width:0
}
.proc-timeline{
  display:grid;
  max-height:430px;
  overflow:auto
}
.proc-movement{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap:9px;
  align-items:start;
  padding:11px 13px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #ece7de
}
.proc-movement:last-child{
  border-bottom:0
}
.proc-movement-marker{
  position:relative;
  width:9px;
  height:9px;
  margin-top:3px;
  border:2px solid #7d9894;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff
}
.proc-movement:not(:last-child) .proc-movement-marker::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:9px;
  left:2px;
  width:1px;
  height:42px;
  background:#d8e0dc
}
.proc-movement.latest .proc-movement-marker{
  border-color:#0d7885;
  background:#0d7885
}
.proc-movement-copy{
  display:grid;
  gap:2px;
  min-width:0
}
.proc-movement-copy strong{
  color:#2d4c56;
  font-size:9.3px;
  line-height:1.3
}
.proc-movement time{
  color:#74837e;
  font-size:7.2px;
  white-space:nowrap
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .proc-movement{
    grid-template-columns:14px minmax(0,1fr)
  }
  .proc-movement time{
    grid-column:2;
  }
}


.proc-structured-filters{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3,minmax(150px,1fr))
    repeat(2,minmax(130px,.8fr));
  gap:8px;
  margin:-2px 0 12px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.96)
}
.proc-structured-filters select,
.proc-structured-filters input{
  width:100%;
  min-height:34px!important;
  font-size:8.4px!important
}
.proc-clear-filters{
  justify-self:start
}
.proc-case-tags,
.proc-tags-chips{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:4px;
  margin-top:4px
}
.proc-process-tag{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:18px;
  padding:2px 7px;
  border:1px solid #d4ddd9;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#f2f6f4;
  color:#38574f;
  font-size:6.8px;
  font-weight:850;
  line-height:1.1;
  letter-spacing:.015em
}
.proc-process-tag.current{
  border-color:#0d7885;
  background:#e5f3f4;
  color:#075c66
}
.proc-process-tag.tag-baixa-definitiva,
.proc-process-tag.tag-transito-em-julgado{
  border-color:#bbd5c6;
  background:#e9f5ee;
  color:#235d43
}
.proc-process-tag.tag-sentenca-julgamento,
.proc-process-tag.tag-procedencia,
.proc-process-tag.tag-procedencia-parcial{
  border-color:#c8d5e1;
  background:#edf3f8;
  color:#315873
}
.proc-process-tag.tag-improcedencia{
  border-color:#e3c8be;
  background:#f9ece7;
  color:#854934
}
.proc-process-tag.tag-tutela,
.proc-process-tag.tag-decisao{
  border-color:#dccfa8;
  background:#f8f3df;
  color:#765d17
}
.proc-process-tag.tag-recurso{
  border-color:#d2c5e3;
  background:#f2edf8;
  color:#654a82
}
.proc-process-tag.tag-rpv-pagamento{
  border-color:#b9d8d2;
  background:#e7f5f2;
  color:#22645a
}
.proc-tags-summary{
  margin-top:10px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border:1px solid #e0ddd5;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:#fbfaf6
}
@media(max-width:1050px){
  .proc-structured-filters{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(140px,1fr))
  }
}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .proc-structured-filters{
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr
  }
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .proc-structured-filters{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.PROC = (()=>{
  const {
    el,button,call,go,alive
  }=App;

  function cpf_(value){
    const d=String(value||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
    return d.length===11
      ?d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})/,'$1.$2.$3-$4')
      :String(value||'');
  }

  function date_(value){
    if(!value)return '—';
    const d=new Date(value);
    if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return String(value||'—');
    return d.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{
      day:'2-digit',
      month:'2-digit',
      year:'numeric',
      hour:'2-digit',
      minute:'2-digit'
    });
  }

  function dateOnly_(value){
    if(!value)return '—';
    const d=new Date(value);
    if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return String(value||'—');
    return d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
  }

  function text_(value){
    return String(value||'').trim()||'—';
  }

  function statusLabel_(status){
    return {
      ATUALIZADO:'Atualizado',
      FALHA:'Falha',
      NAO_LOCALIZADO:'Não localizado',
      NAO_SINCRONIZADO:'Nunca sincronizado'
    }[String(status||'NAO_SINCRONIZADO')]||String(status||'');
  }

  function selectFilter_(placeholder){
    const node=el('select');
    node.append(
      new Option(
        placeholder,
        ''
      )
    );
    return node;
  }

  function fillSelect_(node,values,labeler){
    const current=node.value;
    node.replaceChildren(
      new Option(
        node.dataset.placeholder||'Todos',
        ''
      )
    );

    (values||[]).forEach(value=>{
      if(
        value&&
        typeof value==='object'
      ){
        node.append(
          new Option(
            value.label||value.value,
            value.value
          )
        );
      }else{
        node.append(
          new Option(
            labeler
              ?labeler(value)
              :String(value),
            String(value)
          )
        );
      }
    });

    if(
      [...node.options]
        .some(option=>
          option.value===current
        )
    ){
      node.value=current;
    }
  }

  function tagBadge_(tag){
    return el(
      'span',
      String(tag||''),
      'proc-process-tag tag-'+
      String(tag||'')
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-')
        .replace(/^-|-$/g,'')
    );
  }

  function processItem_(row,active,onOpen){
    const item=el('button',undefined,'proc-case-item'+(active?' active':''));
    item.type='button';

    const icon=el('span',undefined,'proc-case-icon');
    icon.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 4h10l4 4v12H5z"></path><path d="M15 4v5h4"></path><path d="M8 13h8"></path><path d="M8 16h6"></path></svg>';

    const copy=el('span',undefined,'proc-case-copy');
    copy.append(
      el('strong',text_(row.numero)),
      el('span',text_(row.pessoa)),
      el('small',text_(row.jurisdicao))
    );

    const tagLine=
      el(
        'span',
        undefined,
        'proc-case-tags'
      );

    if(row.datajudMarcoAtual){
      tagLine.append(
        tagBadge_(
          row.datajudMarcoAtual
        )
      );
    }

    (row.datajudTags||[])
      .filter(tag=>
        tag&&
        tag!==row.datajudMarcoAtual
      )
      .slice(0,2)
      .forEach(tag=>
        tagLine.append(
          tagBadge_(tag)
        )
      );

    if(tagLine.childElementCount){
      copy.append(tagLine);
    }

    const meta=el('span',undefined,'proc-case-meta');
    const badge=el(
      'span',
      statusLabel_(row.datajudStatus),
      'proc-datajud-mini status-'+String(row.datajudStatus||'NAO_SINCRONIZADO').toLowerCase()
    );
    meta.append(
      badge,
      el('span',row.datajudUltimaConsulta?date_(row.datajudUltimaConsulta):date_(row.distribuidoEm)),
      el('span','›','proc-case-arrow')
    );

    item.append(icon,copy,meta);
    item.onclick=()=>onOpen(row);
    return item;
  }

  function fact_(label,value){
    const box=el('div',undefined,'proc-fact');
    box.append(
      el('span',label),
      el('strong',text_(value))
    );
    return box;
  }

  function timeline_(datajud){
    const section=el('section',undefined,'proc-datajud-section');
    const head=el('div',undefined,'proc-section-head');
    head.append(
      el('div',undefined,'proc-section-title')
    );
    head.firstChild.append(
      el('span','DATAJUD · CNJ','proc-detail-kicker'),
      el('h4','Movimentações processuais')
    );

    const movements=
      datajud&&
      Array.isArray(datajud.movimentos)
        ?datajud.movimentos
        :[];

    head.append(
      el(
        'span',
        movements.length+
        (movements.length===1?' movimento':' movimentos'),
        'proc-count'
      )
    );
    section.append(head);

    const list=el('div',undefined,'proc-timeline');

    if(!movements.length){
      list.append(
        el(
          'p',
          datajud&&datajud.status==='ATUALIZADO'
            ?'O DataJud não retornou movimentações para este processo.'
            :'Atualize o processo pelo DataJud para carregar as movimentações.',
          'proc-empty'
        )
      );
    }else{
      movements.forEach((movement,index)=>{
        const item=el('article',undefined,'proc-movement');
        const marker=el('span',undefined,'proc-movement-marker');
        const copy=el('div',undefined,'proc-movement-copy');
        copy.append(
          el('strong',text_(movement.nome||('Movimento '+movement.codigo))),
          el(
            'span',
            [
              movement.codigo?'TPU '+movement.codigo:'',
              movement.orgao||''
            ].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
            'hint'
          )
        );
        const when=el('time',date_(movement.dataHora));
        item.append(marker,copy,when);
        if(index===0)item.classList.add('latest');
        list.append(item);
      });
    }

    section.append(list);
    return section;
  }

  function renderDetail_(root,row,data,handlers){
    root.replaceChildren();

    const head=el('div',undefined,'proc-detail-head');
    const title=el('div');
    title.append(
      el('span','PROCESSO','proc-detail-kicker'),
      el('h3',text_(row.numero)),
      el('p',text_(row.pessoa),'hint')
    );

    const actions=el('div',undefined,'proc-detail-actions');

    const sync=button(
      data&&data.datajud&&data.datajud.status==='ATUALIZADO'
        ?'Atualizar pelo DataJud'
        :'Consultar DataJud',
      handlers.sync
    );
    sync.classList.add('proc-datajud-sync');

    const preview=button(
      'Visualizar cadastro',
      ()=>App.openPersonDrawer(row.pessoaId)
    );

    const open=button(
      'Abrir ficha completa',
      ()=>{
        App.state.selection=row.pessoaId;
        return go('ACOMP',row.pessoaId);
      },
      true
    );

    actions.append(sync,preview,open);
    head.append(title,actions);
    root.append(head);

    const localFacts=el('div',undefined,'proc-facts');
    localFacts.append(
      fact_('Pessoa',row.pessoa),
      fact_('CPF',cpf_(row.cpf)),
      fact_('Jurisdição',row.jurisdicao),
      fact_('Distribuído em',date_(row.distribuidoEm)),
      fact_('Responsável',row.responsavel)
    );
    root.append(localFacts);

    const dj=(data&&data.datajud)||{};

    if(
      (dj.tags&&dj.tags.length)||
      dj.marcoAtual
    ){
      const tagsBox=
        el(
          'section',
          undefined,
          'proc-tags-summary'
        );

      tagsBox.append(
        el(
          'span',
          'MARCOS PROCESSUAIS',
          'proc-detail-kicker'
        )
      );

      const chips=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'proc-tags-chips'
        );

      if(dj.marcoAtual){
        const current=
          tagBadge_(
            dj.marcoAtual
          );

        current.classList.add(
          'current'
        );

        current.title=
          'Marco processual relevante mais recente';

        chips.append(current);
      }

      (dj.tags||[])
        .filter(tag=>
          tag&&
          tag!==dj.marcoAtual
        )
        .forEach(tag=>
          chips.append(
            tagBadge_(tag)
          )
        );

      tagsBox.append(chips);
      root.append(tagsBox);
    }
    const status=el(
      'section',
      undefined,
      'proc-datajud-status status-'+String(dj.status||'NAO_SINCRONIZADO').toLowerCase()
    );

    const statusCopy=el('div');
    statusCopy.append(
      el('span','FONTE: CONSELHO NACIONAL DE JUSTIÇA · DATAJUD','proc-detail-kicker'),
      el('h4',statusLabel_(dj.status)),
      el(
        'p',
        dj.ultimaConsulta
          ?'Última consulta: '+date_(dj.ultimaConsulta)
          :'Este processo ainda não foi consultado no DataJud.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    if(dj.erro){
      statusCopy.append(
        el('p',dj.erro,'proc-datajud-error')
      );
    }

    status.append(statusCopy);
    root.append(status);

    if(
      dj.status==='ATUALIZADO'||
      dj.tribunal||
      dj.classe||
      dj.orgao
    ){
      const djFacts=el('div',undefined,'proc-facts proc-datajud-facts');
      djFacts.append(
        fact_('Tribunal',dj.tribunal),
        fact_('Grau',dj.grau),
        fact_('Classe processual',dj.classe),
        fact_('Órgão julgador',dj.orgao),
        fact_('Sistema',dj.sistema),
        fact_('Data de ajuizamento',dateOnly_(dj.dataAjuizamento)),
        fact_('Nível de sigilo',dj.nivelSigilo),
        fact_(
          'Assuntos',
          Array.isArray(dj.assuntos)&&dj.assuntos.length
            ?dj.assuntos.join(' · ')
            :'—'
        ),
        fact_(
          'Atualização na origem',
          date_(dj.ultimaAtualizacaoOrigem)
        )
      );
      root.append(djFacts);
    }

    root.append(timeline_(dj));

    const note=el('section',undefined,'proc-detail-note');
    note.append(
      el('h4','Sobre a integração'),
      el(
        'p',
        'A consulta ao DataJud ocorre somente quando solicitada nesta tela. Os dados locais continuam disponíveis mesmo se a API do CNJ estiver indisponível. O DataJud fornece metadados processuais públicos e não substitui o acesso ao inteiro teor no sistema do tribunal.',
        'hint'
      )
    );
    root.append(note);
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;
    const requestedProcessId=
      App.state.selection&&
      typeof App.state.selection==='object'&&
      App.state.selection.processoId
        ?String(App.state.selection.processoId)
        :'';

    if(requestedProcessId){
      App.state.selection=null;
    }

    const toolbar=el('div',undefined,'proc-toolbar');
    const search=el('input');
    search.type='search';
    search.placeholder='Buscar por número, pessoa, CPF, jurisdição ou dados do DataJud';
    search.autocomplete='off';

    const count=el('span','','proc-count');
    toolbar.append(search,count);
    root.append(toolbar);

    const filters=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'proc-structured-filters'
      );

    const tribunal=
      selectFilter_(
        'Todos os tribunais'
      );
    tribunal.dataset.placeholder=
      'Todos os tribunais';

    const classe=
      selectFilter_(
        'Todas as classes'
      );
    classe.dataset.placeholder=
      'Todas as classes';

    const orgao=
      selectFilter_(
        'Todos os órgãos'
      );
    orgao.dataset.placeholder=
      'Todos os órgãos';

    const statusFilter=
      selectFilter_(
        'Status DataJud'
      );
    statusFilter.dataset.placeholder=
      'Status DataJud';

    const marco=
      selectFilter_(
        'Marco atual'
      );
    marco.dataset.placeholder=
      'Marco atual';

    const tag=
      selectFilter_(
        'Tag processual'
      );
    tag.dataset.placeholder=
      'Tag processual';

    const movDe=el('input');
    movDe.type='date';
    movDe.title='Última movimentação a partir de';

    const movAte=el('input');
    movAte.type='date';
    movAte.title='Última movimentação até';

    const clearFilters=
      button(
        'Limpar filtros',
        ()=>{
          [
            tribunal,
            classe,
            orgao,
            statusFilter,
            marco,
            tag,
            movDe,
            movAte
          ].forEach(node=>
            node.value=''
          );

          search.value='';
          load_(0,false).catch(()=>{});
        },
        true
      );

    clearFilters.classList.add(
      'proc-clear-filters'
    );

    filters.append(
      tribunal,
      classe,
      orgao,
      statusFilter,
      marco,
      tag,
      movDe,
      movAte,
      clearFilters
    );

    root.append(filters);

    const layout=el('div',undefined,'proc-layout');
    const list=el('section',undefined,'proc-list');
    const detail=el('section',undefined,'proc-detail');

    const more=button(
      'Carregar mais processos',
      ()=>load_(rows.length,true),
      true
    );
    more.classList.add('proc-more');

    layout.append(list,detail);
    root.append(layout,more);

    let rows=[];
    let total=0;
    let hasMore=false;
    let selected=null;
    let requestSeq=0;
    let detailSeq=0;
    let searchTimer=null;
    const detailCache=new Map();

    const renderList_=()=>{
      count.textContent=
        rows.length+
        ' de '+
        total+
        ' processo'+
        (total===1?'':'s');

      list.replaceChildren();

      if(!rows.length){
        list.append(
          el('p','Nenhum processo encontrado.','proc-empty')
        );
        more.hidden=true;
        return;
      }

      rows.forEach(row=>{
        list.append(
          processItem_(
            row,
            selected&&row.id===selected.id,
            openProcess_
          )
        );
      });

      more.hidden=!hasMore;
      more.disabled=false;
      more.textContent='Carregar mais processos';
    };

    const loadDetail_=async row=>{
      const seq=++detailSeq;
      detail.replaceChildren(
        el('p','Carregando dados do processo…','proc-empty')
      );

      let data=detailCache.get(row.id);

      if(!data){
        data=await call(
          'processoDetalhe',
          {id:row.id},
          false,
          {noLoader:true}
        );

        detailCache.set(row.id,data);
      }

      if(
        seq!==detailSeq||
        !alive(ctx)||
        !selected||
        selected.id!==row.id
      ){
        return;
      }

      const sync_=async()=>{
        const syncButton=
          detail.querySelector(
            '.proc-datajud-sync'
          );

        if(syncButton){
          syncButton.disabled=true;
          syncButton.textContent='Consultando DataJud…';
        }

        try{
          const result=await call(
            'processoDatajudSincronizar',
            {id:row.id},
            true,
            {silent:true}
          );

          const fresh=await call(
            'processoDetalhe',
            {id:row.id},
            false,
            {noLoader:true}
          );

          detailCache.set(row.id,fresh);

          Object.assign(row,{
            datajudStatus:
              fresh.datajud&&fresh.datajud.status||
              'NAO_SINCRONIZADO',
            datajudUltimaConsulta:
              fresh.datajud&&fresh.datajud.ultimaConsulta||
              '',
            datajudTribunal:
              fresh.datajud&&fresh.datajud.tribunal||
              '',
            datajudTags:
              fresh.datajud&&fresh.datajud.tags||
              [],
            datajudMarcoAtual:
              fresh.datajud&&fresh.datajud.marcoAtual||
              '',
            datajudUltimaMovimentacao:
              fresh.datajud&&fresh.datajud.ultimaMovimentacao||
              ''
          });

          renderList_();
          renderDetail_(
            detail,
            row,
            fresh,
            {sync:sync_}
          );

          App.status(
            result.mensagem||
            (
              result.ok
                ?'Processo atualizado pelo DataJud.'
                :'A consulta ao DataJud não foi concluída.'
            ),
            !result.ok
          );

        }catch(error){
          App.status(
            error.message||
            String(error),
            true
          );

          if(syncButton&&syncButton.isConnected){
            syncButton.disabled=false;
            syncButton.textContent='Tentar novamente';
          }
        }
      };

      renderDetail_(
        detail,
        row,
        data,
        {sync:sync_}
      );
    };

    function openProcess_(row){
      selected=row;
      renderList_();
      loadDetail_(row).catch(error=>{
        detail.replaceChildren(
          el(
            'p',
            error.message||String(error),
            'warn'
          )
        );
      });
    }

    const load_=async(offset,append=false)=>{
      const request=++requestSeq;
      const term=String(search.value||'').trim();

      const filterPayload={
        tribunal:tribunal.value,
        classe:classe.value,
        orgao:orgao.value,
        status:statusFilter.value,
        marco:marco.value,
        tag:tag.value,
        movDe:movDe.value,
        movAte:movAte.value
      };

      if(!append){
        rows=[];
        selected=null;
        detailSeq++;
        list.replaceChildren(
          el('p','Carregando processos…','hint')
        );
        detail.replaceChildren(
          el('p','Selecione um processo nos resultados.','hint')
        );
      }else{
        more.disabled=true;
        more.textContent='Carregando…';
      }

      const data=await call(
        'processos',
        Object.assign(
          {
            busca:term,
            offset,
            limit:50
          },
          filterPayload
        ),
        false,
        {noLoader:true}
      );

      if(
        request!==requestSeq||
        !alive(ctx)
      ){
        return;
      }

      if(append){
        rows.push(...(data.processos||[]));
      }else{
        rows=[...(data.processos||[])];
      }

      total=Number(data.total||0);
      hasMore=!!data.hasMore;
      renderList_();

      if(rows.length&&!selected){
        openProcess_(rows[0]);
      }else if(!rows.length){
        detail.replaceChildren(
          el('p','Nenhum processo corresponde ao filtro informado.','hint')
        );
      }
    };

    search.addEventListener('input',()=>{
      if(searchTimer){
        clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      }

      searchTimer=setTimeout(
        ()=>load_(0,false).catch(()=>{}),
        260
      );
    });

    [
      tribunal,
      classe,
      orgao,
      statusFilter,
      marco,
      tag,
      movDe,
      movAte
    ].forEach(node=>{
      node.addEventListener(
        'change',
        ()=>load_(0,false).catch(()=>{})
      );
    });

    call(
      'processoFiltros',
      {},
      false,
      {noLoader:true}
    )
      .then(options=>{
        fillSelect_(
          tribunal,
          options.tribunais
        );
        fillSelect_(
          classe,
          options.classes
        );
        fillSelect_(
          orgao,
          options.orgaos
        );
        fillSelect_(
          statusFilter,
          options.status
        );
        fillSelect_(
          marco,
          options.marcos
        );
        fillSelect_(
          tag,
          options.tags
        );
      })
      .catch(()=>{});

    await load_(0,false);

    if(requestedProcessId&&alive(ctx)){
      try{
        const exact=await call(
          'processoDetalhe',
          {id:requestedProcessId},
          false,
          {noLoader:true}
        );

        if(!alive(ctx))return;

        let row=rows.find(item=>item.id===requestedProcessId);
        if(row){
          Object.assign(row,exact,{id:requestedProcessId});
        }else{
          row=Object.assign({},exact,{id:requestedProcessId});
          rows.unshift(row);
        }

        detailCache.set(requestedProcessId,exact);
        renderList_();
        openProcess_(row);
      }catch(error){
        App.status(
          error.message||'Não foi possível abrir o processo vinculado ao prazo.',
          true
        );
      }
    }
  };
})();
</script>
